### 6. Problem tree derived from visible materials alone
Root (customer's ask): builder-delay waiver of the extension cost caused by Calloway's delay.
- Hop 1 (waiver <- extension charge), state-derived: builder_delay_charge_waivers: "The builder-delay waiver is not fixed until the lock ledger carries, under its own charge number, the extension charge for the days added to reach the moved closing date." Lock ledger: no extension fee charge. Searching "extension fee charge" finds extension_charge_booking: "Extensions … are priced by an extension fee charge on the lock ledger … under its own printed charge number" (its tool writes that charge).
- Hop 2 (extension charge <- extension written), state-derived: extension_charge_booking: "The extension fee is fixed only after the lock record carries the extension it prices, its days counted in the extension days used beyond the extension days already charged on the lock ledger." Lock record: extension_days_used 0. Searching "extension days used" finds lock_extension_requests, whose buyer tool "adds the days to the extension days used on the lock".
- Hop 3 (extension <- relock), state-derived: lock_extension_requests: "For a lock whose record carries an expired date, the extension days are worked out only once its status on record reads locked again and its relocks used count includes the relock that returned it to locked." Lock record: status expired, expired_date 2026-09-26, relocks_used 0. Searching "relocks used"/"expired" finds expired_lock_relocking: "the lock status becomes locked … the number of relocks used on the lock goes up by one".
- Order: relock -> extension (buyer) -> extension charge -> waiver. Direction: each earlier write establishes the state the next sentence waits on. Every relock is inside its window (day 18 of 30).
- No hop was pre-solved: no hub names another problem's tool (each tool name occurs in exactly one document, its own hub), no route or chain document was met.

Note: the records show only the current dates; that the slip already stood at expiry rests on the 09-22 closing date notice — recorded as a visibility observation, not a defect.
